name: Yakin Byoutou Zero
source: This is the back story of how the genius doctor Hirasaka Ryuuji acquired his perverted pastime as a med school student. He and Jinguuji Narumi are rivals at the top of their class. One day, Narumi tells him that if he can seduce the woman she designates in the 2 weeks before graduation, she'll admit her defeat and do anything he tells her. The girls she suggests are just as beautiful and desirable as herself. Sensing his perverted perceptions transforming into a talent at her tantalizing suggestion, he readily agrees.
translation: 这是一段前传故事，讲述天才医生比良坂龙二在医学院求学时，是如何染上变态嗜好的。他与神宫寺成美同为班级顶尖的劲敌。某天，成美告诉他：如果毕业前两周内，他能勾引她指定的女人，她便承认落败，并答应满足他的任何要求。她挑出的女孩都与本人一样美丽诱人。这项挑逗十足的提议令龙二意识到，自己扭曲的眼光或许正转化为一种天赋，于是欣然应战。
